scope_review.immediate_and_shared_heap_widening: Local edge lookup admits exact original output roots only. Seed membership now produces a precise OriginalMember: expandable Node subroot or exact terminal opaque/i31. The containing seed node is not returned as the member permission. FactoryPoint carries this scope through retained FactoryReference links. Restricted lookup executes before unrestricted factory-node seen handling and continues without expanding the containing factory node. This addresses both previously identified direct and linked member-to-container widening paths.
scope_review.genuine_downward_semantics: Snapshot traversal starts at the original selected Node, follows only its recorded outgoing child atoms, and deduplicates original Node indices iteratively. It can admit genuine descendants, including through cycles with actual recorded edges; it cannot obtain unrelated inventory nodes merely because they share a snapshot. Opaque and immediate terminal matching does not expand via another seed/node.
scope_review.owner_binding: CanonicalSeed checks Session owner and upgrades the SeedMember weak owner, requiring exact Arc::ptr_eq before applying a node index to storage. All production bare OriginalMember calls are mediated by that binding. No strong seed/domain predecessor chain, current guest recapture, mutable validity flag, source certificate or public capability introduced.
scope_review.current_proofs: Full predecessor-domain validation, strict-child method-context isolation, target-only staged receipt, existing source_safe/719 receipt semantics and error propagation are unchanged. Member restriction is not a replacement for full current domain validation.
scope_review.lifecycle: OriginalMember is a flat node index or rooted terminal value. SeedMember adds a weak seed handle. FactoryPoint retained copies preserve the restriction; no recursive proof ownership introduced. Original full-scope domain lifetimes and iterative Native release remain separate.
